Trader Djingo is a gold dwarf in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.

Involvement

Act Three

Trader Djingo and his clients  Kaet Ling,  Smiley Gheef, and  Pheebs Splayfoot can be encountered at the pier of the Grey Harbour Docks at X: -219 Y: -155 after having successfully resolved the conflict between  Dharin Brislen and  Captain Sleam and long resting at least once. They can be spoken with, but these interactions carry no consequence for the party.

Idle banter

  • Pheebs Splayfoot
    All right, how much for the saltpetre, including fees?
  • Trader Djingo
    Depends. How many barrels?
  • Pheebs Splayfoot
    All of them.
  • Trader Djingo
    500 gold, at least 100 in coin.
  • Pheebs Splayfoot
    That's harbour robbery, especially when it's been in storage for months.
  • Trader Djingo
    We both know you'll sell it for twice that to the armoury once the city's under siege.
  • Smiley Gheef
    Too right. I'll go 600.
  • Pheebs Splayfoot
    Hey, I was here first. 700.
  • Kaet Ling
    A thousand gold, all in cash, no notes.
  • Trader Djingo
    Sold! A pleasure doing business with you, saer.
